name: Oath Blade
description: A short vow hammered into the fuller.

name: Chapel Mace
description: A blunt chapel weight. Foes notice the swing.

name: Reed Staff
description: A river reed bound with copper wire. Needs both hands.

name: Sap Crook
description: A shepherd's crook that still smells of sap.

name: Thorn Bow
description: A hedge limb and a waxed string. Both hands.

name: Pocket Knife
description: A folding blade for a free hand or the main one.

name: Road Lute
description: Travels better than it tunes.

name: Gravel Axe
description: A road-crew axe. Both hands, no argument.

name: Kiln Sword
description: Fired in a brick kiln until the edge went blue.

name: Lamp Staff
description: The head is a lamp that never quite goes out.

name: Marsh Bow
description: Waxed against the damp. The string still sings.

name: Night Shard
description: A sliver of black glass. Main hand or off hand.

name: Sunbrand
description: A two-handed brand that throws a long shadow at noon.

name: Kettle Shield
description: A pot lid with a strap. It has stopped worse.

name: Hymn Board
description: A chapel board. The painted verse is almost worn off.

name: Glass Orb
description: A palm-glass full of slow light.

name: Oak Buckler
description: A round of oak with an iron rose in the middle.

name: Void Lens
description: Looking through it makes the room feel larger.

name: Travel Coat
description: Waxed wool. Every class can throw it on.

name: Reed Wrap
description: A marsh cloak that does not snag on brambles.

name: Hedge Mail
description: Rings sewn into a hedge-green jack.

name: Kiln Plate
description: Brick-red plate. Too heavy for a light step.

name: Moon Robe
description: Pale cloth that drinks lamplight.

name: Keep Plate
description: The keep's spare harness. It still has no banner.

name: Bread Charm
description: A crust wrapped in thread. It steadies the stomach.

name: Wick Ring
description: A copper ring with a stub of candlewick.

name: Pond Bead
description: A glass bead the color of mill water.

name: Threat Bell
description: A tiny bell. Foes look over when it does not ring.

name: Ley Locket
description: A locket that hums when a spell is close.

name: Grinning Crown
description: A ring of dried blue that still smiles.

name: Howl Fang
description: A duskbat tooth on a cord. It wants a quiet hand.

name: Brute Heart
description: A stone heart from the cairn golem, warm as a hearth brick.

name: Bone Plate
description: A pale plate off the reed skeleton.

name: Cap Jar
description: Light scraped from an orangecap and corked.

name: Hearth Tonic
description: Restores 50 health.

name: Lamp Vial
description: Restores 40 energy.

name: Loaf Crumb
description: Restores 18 health. Travels in a pocket.

name: Blue Ether
description: Restores 90 energy.

name: Field Salve
description: Restores 90 health.

name: Kettle Dram
description: Restores 30 health and 30 energy.

name: Reed Tongue
description: A wide toad's tongue, salted for the miller.

name: Slime Gel
description: Blue gel scraped off a Blueslime.

name: Thorn Chip
description: A green chip from a Thorn Gob.

name: Wolf Burr
description: A burr pulled from a Briar Wolf's coat.

name: Toad Wart
description: A dried wart from a Grinmud Toad.

name: Crab Shell
description: A Bottlecrab shell, heavy enough for a lamp chain.

name: Gull Feather
description: A stiff feather from a Squallgull.

name: Cap Spore
description: A glowing spore from an Orangecap.

name: Kelp Scale
description: A scale from a Kelpback Snapper.

name: Bat Ear
description: A leathery ear from a Duskbat.

name: Bone Chip
description: A chip of Reedbones.

name: Grub Silk
description: A strand of Gloomgrub silk.

name: Fang Venom
description: A drop of Dripfang venom in a chip of glass.

name: Squire Pebble
description: A pebble shed by a Pebble Squire.

name: Helm Rivet
description: A rivet from a Hollow Helm.

name: Rat Whisker
description: A whisker from a Cobble Rat.

name: Golem Grit
description: Grit ground off a Cairn Golem.

name: Salt Mace
description: A chapel mace crusted with dry salt.

name: Pier Lute
description: Tuned to the tide. The pegs still taste of brine.

name: Tide Axe
description: A dock axe. Both hands, and it never quite dries.

name: Brine Orb
description: Seawater caught in glass. It leans toward the lamp.

name: Salt Jack
description: A waxed jack stiff with salt. Medium weight.

name: Cleft Sword
description: A one-handed blade nicked by the cliff wind.

name: Ash Mace
description: The head is a lump of cooled ash-stone.

name: Drip Staff
description: Water beads on the grain and never falls. Both hands.

name: Echo Bow
description: The string answers the cleft. Both hands.

name: Cave Shard
description: A flake of cave glass. Main hand or off hand.

name: Ash Lute
description: Soot in the sound hole. It still finds a tune.

name: Cliff Axe
description: A quarry axe. Both hands, and the edge drinks sparks.

name: Slate Shield
description: A slab of cliff slate with a rope grip.

name: Ash Coat
description: Pale cloth that sheds cave dust. Light.

name: Drip Mail
description: Rings that stay cold. Medium weight.

name: Cleft Bead
description: A stone bead that ticks when the cleft answers.

name: Cave Draught
description: Restores 140 health.

name: Deep Vial
description: Restores 140 energy.

name: Gate Sword
description: A one-handed sword from the tent stalls. It keeps a shield hand free.

name: Banner Mace
description: No banner hangs from it. Foes look anyway.

name: Keep Staff
description: A staff cut from a walking stone's shadow. Both hands.

name: Gravel Bow
description: The limbs are stone-dust and horn. Both hands.

name: Gate Knife
description: A market knife with a pebble pommel. Main hand or off hand.

name: Stone Lute
description: The body is thin stone. It rings longer than it should.

name: Cairn Axe
description: An axe that remembers the golem's swing. Both hands.

name: Gate Shield
description: A stall shield. The boss is a flat river stone.

name: Keep Orb
description: A pebble of the keep, still warm, set in a brass cup.

name: Gate Robe
description: A stall robe lined with pebble-wool. Light.

name: Pebble Mail
description: Mail with a pebble at every ring. Medium.

name: Cairn Plate
description: Plate knocked off a walking stone. Heavy.

name: March Token
description: A clay token from the tent road. Foes count you twice.

name: Keep Dram
description: Restores 120 health and 80 energy.

name: Gel Edge
description: A folding blade glazed with slime gel. Sharper than the stall knife.

name: Burr Cloak
description: Wolf burrs stitched into a light cloak. It turns a thorn.

name: Kettle Band
description: A copper band boiled in the inn kettle. Steadier than a bread charm.

name: Shell Buckler
description: A crab shell on an oak round. More plate than the stall buckler, and no extra heft.

name: Tide Crook
description: A staff capped with kelp scale. It leans into spells instead of a lamp. Both hands.

name: Gull Charm
description: Three gull feathers on a cord. The eye is sharper than a pond bead.

name: Silk Mail
description: Grub silk packed under medium rings. It gives more than the stall mail.

name: Fang Needle
description: A dripfang tooth on a cave shard. Meaner than the stall knife.

name: Drip Bead
description: Cave water in a bone bead. It feeds a spell, not a swing.

name: Grit Axe
description: Golem grit hammered into an axe face. Heavier in the cut than the stall axe. Both hands.

name: Rivet Plate
description: Helm rivets sunk into heavy plate. More shell than the cairn harness, less bulk.

name: Whisker Charm
description: Cobble-rat whiskers in a pebble clasp. It favors a lucky nick.
